stanza: Now you're a good surveyor, Dixon
But I swear you'll make me mad
The West will kill us both
You gullible Geordie lad
You talk of liberty
How can America be free
A Geordie and a baker's boy
In the forests of the Iroquois

stanza: Little Indian kids on a bridge up in Canada
They can balance and they can climb
Like their fathers before them
They'll walk the girders of the Manhattan skyline

liberty.line: The Statue of Liberty sailing away to sea

stanza: And I dreamed I was dying
I dreamed that my soul rose unexpectedly
And looking back down at me, smiled reassuringly
And I dreamed I was flying
And high up above, my eyes could clearly see
The Statue of Liberty sailing away to sea
And I dreamed I was flying

liberty.songTitle: Last Words of a Shooting Star
liberty.linePrev: But I know through mine, you were looking in yours
liberty.line: And did you know the Liberty Bell is a replica
liberty.lineNext: Silently housed in its original walls
stanza: And did you know the Liberty Bell is a replica
Silently housed in its original walls
And while its dreams played music in the night
Quietly, it was told to believe
